decision_conditions: Prior to the commencement of development, a site drainage strategy must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing. The submitted scheme must:(i) include the results of on-site infiltration testing to BRE Digest 365;(ii) provide details of all proposed SuDS measures to delay and control the rate of surface water discharged from the site in line with the Mayor's drainage hierarchy;(iii) include calculations carried out by an appropriately qualified professional to show that, as far as practicable, the peak run-off rate for the 1 in 100 year 6- hour rainfall event (plus 40% for climate change) will achieve greenfield run-off rates and volumes for the same event; and(iv) demonstrate that the 1 in 30 year rainfall event (plus 40% for climate change) can be contained without flooding; any flooding occurring between the 1 in 30 and 1 in 100 year event (plus 40% for climate change) will be safely contained on site; and that rainfall in excess of the 1 in 100 year event is managed to minimise risks;(v) provide a management and maintenance schedule.Reason: To comply with London Plan Policy SI13 and Policy 32 of the Local Plan 2018.
